papers.summary_en: ScreenQA is a new dataset with 86k question-answer pairs over mobile app screenshots, designed to benchmark screen reading comprehension. It includes full answers, short phrases, and UI bounding boxes, supporting four subtasks for different applications. Evaluations on open-weight and proprietary models show effectiveness in zero-shot, fine-tuned, and transfer learning settings, with positive transfer to web apps.
papers.summary_zh: ScreenQA是一个新数据集，包含86k个关于移动应用截图的问答对，旨在评估屏幕阅读理解能力。它提供完整答案、短语和UI边界框，支持四个子任务以适应不同应用场景。在零样本、微调和迁移学习设置下对开源和闭源模型的评估显示了其有效性，并正向迁移到网页应用。

papers.title: CRMArena: Understanding the Capacity of LLM Agents to Perform Professional CRM Tasks in Realistic Environments
papers.short_title: CRMArena: LLM Agents for CRM Tasks
papers.abstract: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems are vital for modern enterprises, providing a foundation for managing customer interactions and data. Integrating AI agents into CRM systems can automate routine processes and enhance personalized service. However, deploying and evaluating these agents is challenging due to the lack of realistic benchmarks that reflect the complexity of real-world CRM tasks. To address this issue, we introduce CRMArena, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate AI agents on realistic tasks grounded in professional work environments. Following guidance from CRM experts and industry best practices, we designed CRMArena with nine customer service tasks distributed across three personas: service agent, analyst, and manager. The benchmark includes 16 commonly used industrial objects (e.g., account, order, knowledge article, case) with high interconnectivity, along with latent variables (e.g., complaint habits, policy violations) to simulate realistic data distributions. Experimental results reveal that state-of-the-art LLM agents succeed in less than 40% of the tasks with ReAct prompting, and less than 55% even with function-calling abilities. Our findings highlight the need for enhanced agent capabilities in function-calling and rule-following to be deployed in real-world work environments. CRMArena is an open challenge to the community: systems that can reliably complete tasks showcase direct business value in a popular work environment.
papers.summary_en: CRMArena is a new benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on realistic CRM tasks, featuring nine tasks across three personas and 16 interconnected industrial objects with latent variables. Experiments show that current LLM agents succeed in less than 40% of tasks with ReAct prompting and under 55% with function calling, highlighting the need for improved function-calling and rule-following capabilities.
papers.summary_zh: CRMArena是一个新的基准测试，用于评估LLM代理在真实CRM任务上的表现，包含三个角色的九项任务和16个高度互联的工业对象及潜在变量。实验表明，当前LLM代理在ReAct提示下任务成功率不足40%，即使具备函数调用能力也不到55%，凸显了提升函数调用和规则遵循能力的必要性。

papers.title: CowPilot: A Framework for Autonomous and Human-Agent Collaborative Web Navigation
papers.short_title: CowPilot: Human-Agent Collaborative Web Navigation
papers.abstract: While much work on web agents emphasizes the promise of autonomously performing tasks on behalf of users, in reality, agents often fall short on complex tasks in real-world contexts and modeling user preference. This presents an opportunity for humans to collaborate with the agent and leverage the agent's capabilities effectively. We propose CowPilot, a framework supporting autonomous as well as human-agent collaborative web navigation, and evaluation across task success and task efficiency. CowPilot reduces the number of steps humans need to perform by allowing agents to propose next steps, while users are able to pause, reject, or take alternative actions. During execution, users can interleave their actions with the agent by overriding suggestions or resuming agent control when needed. We conducted case studies on five common websites and found that the human-agent collaborative mode achieves the highest success rate of 95% while requiring humans to perform only 15.2% of the total steps. Even with human interventions during task execution, the agent successfully drives up to half of task success on its own. CowPilot can serve as a useful tool for data collection and agent evaluation across websites, which we believe will enable research in how users and agents can work together. Video demonstrations are available at https://oaishi.github.io/cowpilot.html
papers.summary_en: CowPilot is a framework that enables both autonomous and human-agent collaborative web navigation, allowing users to interleave their actions with an AI agent's suggestions. In case studies on five websites, the collaborative mode achieved a 95% success rate while requiring humans to perform only 15.2% of the steps. The framework reduces human effort by letting the agent propose actions, which users can accept, reject, or override, making it useful for data collection and agent evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: CowPilot是一个支持自主导航和人机协作网页导航的框架，允许用户与AI代理的建议交替执行操作。在五个网站上的案例研究中，协作模式实现了95%的成功率，而人类仅需执行15.2%的步骤。该框架通过让代理提出操作建议（用户可接受、拒绝或覆盖）来减少人类工作量，并可用于数据收集和代理评估。

papers.title: RxLens: Multi-Agent LLM-powered Scan and Order for Pharmacy
papers.short_title: RxLens: Multi-Agent LLM for Pharmacy
papers.abstract: Automated construction of shopping cart from medical prescriptions is a vital prerequisite for scaling up online pharmaceutical services in emerging markets due to the high prevalence of paper prescriptions that are challenging for customers to interpret. We present RxLens, a multi-step end-end Large Language Model (LLM)-based deployed solution for automated pharmacy cart construction comprising multiple steps: redaction of Personal Identifiable Information (PII), Optical Character Recognition (OCR), medication extraction, matching against the catalog, and bounding box detection for lineage. Our multi-step design leverages the synergy between retrieval and LLM-based generation to mitigate the vocabulary gaps in LLMs and fuzzy matching errors during retrieval. Empirical evaluation demonstrates that RxLens can yield up to 19% - 40% and 11% - 26% increase in Recall@3 relative to SOTA methods such as Medical Comprehend and vanilla retrieval augmentation of LLMs on handwritten and printed prescriptions respectively. We also explore LLM-based auto-evaluation as an alternative to costly manual annotations and observe a 76% - 100% match relative to human judgements on various tasks.
papers.summary_en: RxLens is a multi-agent LLM system that automates pharmacy cart construction from medical prescriptions by combining OCR, medication extraction, catalog matching, and bounding box detection. It uses a multi-step design integrating retrieval and LLM generation to overcome vocabulary gaps and fuzzy matching errors, achieving 19-40% and 11-26% higher Recall@3 than SOTA methods on handwritten and printed prescriptions. The system also introduces LLM-based auto-evaluation, which matches human judgments 76-100% of the time, reducing the need for costly manual annotations.
papers.summary_zh: RxLens是一个多智能体大语言模型系统，通过结合OCR、药物提取、目录匹配和边界框检测，自动从医疗处方构建购物车。其多步设计融合检索与LLM生成，克服了词汇鸿沟和模糊匹配错误，在手写和打印处方上分别比现有最优方法（如Medical Comprehend和普通检索增强LLM）的Recall@3高出19-40%和11-26%。系统还引入了基于LLM的自动评估，与人工判断的匹配率达76-100%，减少了对昂贵人工标注的依赖。

papers.title: EgoSpeak: Learning When to Speak for Egocentric Conversational Agents in the Wild
papers.short_title: EgoSpeak: Speech Initiation for Egocentric Agents
papers.abstract: Predicting when to initiate speech in real-world environments remains a fundamental challenge for conversational agents. We introduce EgoSpeak, a novel framework for real-time speech initiation prediction in egocentric streaming video. By modeling the conversation from the speaker's first-person viewpoint, EgoSpeak is tailored for human-like interactions in which a conversational agent must continuously observe its environment and dynamically decide when to talk. Our approach bridges the gap between simplified experimental setups and complex natural conversations by integrating four key capabilities: (1) first-person perspective, (2) RGB processing, (3) online processing, and (4) untrimmed video processing. We also present YT-Conversation, a diverse collection of in-the-wild conversational videos from YouTube, as a resource for large-scale pretraining. Experiments on EasyCom and Ego4D demonstrate that EgoSpeak outperforms random and silence-based baselines in real time. Our results also highlight the importance of multimodal input and context length in effectively deciding when to speak.
papers.summary_en: EgoSpeak is a framework that predicts when a conversational agent should start speaking in real-world, egocentric video streams. It processes RGB video from a first-person perspective in real time, using untrimmed footage to decide when to talk. The model outperforms random and silence-based baselines on the EasyCom and Ego4D datasets, and the authors release a new YouTube dataset for pretraining. Key findings show that multimodal input and longer context improve prediction accuracy.
papers.summary_zh: EgoSpeak是一个框架，用于预测对话代理在真实世界的第一人称视频流中何时应该开始说话。它从第一人称视角实时处理RGB视频，利用未剪辑的片段来决定何时发言。该模型在EasyCom和Ego4D数据集上优于随机和基于静默的基线方法，作者还发布了一个新的YouTube数据集用于预训练。关键发现表明，多模态输入和更长的上下文能提高预测准确性。

papers.title: Sketch2Code: Evaluating Vision-Language Models for Interactive Web Design Prototyping
papers.short_title: Sketch2Code: VLM for Web Design Prototyping
papers.abstract: Sketches are a natural and accessible medium for UI designers to conceptualize early-stage ideas. However, existing research on UI/UX automation often requires high-fidelity inputs like Figma designs or detailed screenshots, limiting accessibility and impeding efficient design iteration. To bridge this gap, we introduce Sketch2Code, a benchmark that evaluates state-of-the-art Vision Language Models (VLMs) on automating the conversion of rudimentary sketches into webpage prototypes. Beyond end-to-end benchmarking, Sketch2Code supports interactive agent evaluation that mimics real-world design workflows, where a VLM-based agent iteratively refines its generations by communicating with a simulated user, either passively receiving feedback instructions or proactively asking clarification questions. We comprehensively analyze ten commercial and open-source models, showing that Sketch2Code is challenging for existing VLMs; even the most capable models struggle to accurately interpret sketches and formulate effective questions that lead to steady improvement. Nevertheless, a user study with UI/UX experts reveals a significant preference for proactive question-asking over passive feedback reception, highlighting the need to develop more effective paradigms for multi-turn conversational agents.
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces Sketch2Code, a benchmark for evaluating vision-language models on converting hand-drawn UI sketches into webpage prototypes. It supports both end-to-end testing and interactive agent evaluation, where models iteratively refine outputs by receiving user feedback or asking clarifying questions. Experiments show that current models struggle with sketch interpretation and effective questioning, but a user study reveals that proactive question-asking is preferred over passive feedback reception, highlighting the need for better multi-turn conversational agents.
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出了Sketch2Code基准，用于评估视觉语言模型将手绘UI草图转换为网页原型的能力。该基准支持端到端测试和交互式智能体评估，其中模型通过接收用户反馈或主动提问来迭代优化输出。实验表明，现有模型在草图理解和有效提问方面存在困难，但用户研究发现主动提问比被动接收反馈更受青睐，凸显了开发更优多轮对话智能体的必要性。

papers.title: Evaluating Cultural and Social Awareness of LLM Web Agents
papers.short_title: Cultural Awareness of LLM Web Agents
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) expand into performing as agents for real-world applications beyond traditional NLP tasks, evaluating their robustness becomes increasingly important. However, existing benchmarks often overlook critical dimensions like cultural and social awareness. To address these, we introduce CASA, a benchmark designed to assess LLM agents' sensitivity to cultural and social norms across two web-based tasks: online shopping and social discussion forums. Our approach evaluates LLM agents' ability to detect and appropriately respond to norm-violating user queries and observations. Furthermore, we propose a comprehensive evaluation framework that measures awareness coverage, helpfulness in managing user queries, and the violation rate when facing misleading web content. Experiments show that current LLMs perform significantly better in non-agent than in web-based agent environments, with agents achieving less than 10% awareness coverage and over 40% violation rates. To improve performance, we explore two methods: prompting and fine-tuning, and find that combining both methods can offer complementary advantages -- fine-tuning on culture-specific datasets significantly enhances the agents' ability to generalize across different regions, while prompting boosts the agents' ability to navigate complex tasks. These findings highlight the importance of constantly benchmarking LLM agents' cultural and social awareness during the development cycle.
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces CASA, a benchmark to evaluate cultural and social awareness of LLM agents in web-based tasks like online shopping and forums. It finds that current LLM agents perform poorly, with less than 10% awareness coverage and over 40% violation rates. Combining fine-tuning on culture-specific data with prompting improves generalization and task navigation, highlighting the need for ongoing evaluation of these dimensions.
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出了CASA基准，用于评估LLM代理在网购和论坛等网络任务中的文化与社会意识。实验发现，当前LLM代理表现不佳，意识覆盖率不足10%，违规率超过40%。结合文化特定数据的微调与提示方法可提升泛化能力和任务导航，强调了在开发过程中持续评估这些维度的必要性。

papers.title: Cerebrum (AIOS SDK): A Platform for Agent Development, Deployment, Distribution, and Discovery
papers.short_title: Cerebrum: Agent Dev & Deployment Platform
papers.abstract: Autonomous LLM-based agents have emerged as a powerful paradigm for complex task execution, yet the field lacks standardized tools for development, deployment, distribution and discovery of agents. We present Cerebrum, an Agent SDK for AIOS that addresses this gap through three key components: (1) a comprehensive SDK featuring a modular four-layer architecture for agent development, encompassing LLM, memory, storage, and tool management; (2) a community-driven Agent Hub for sharing and discovering agents, complete with version control and dependency management; (3) an interactive web interface for testing and evaluating agents. The platform's effectiveness is demonstrated through implementations of various agent architectures, including Chain of Thought (CoT), ReAct, and tool-use agents. Cerebrum advances the field by providing a unified framework that standardizes agent development while maintaining flexibility for researchers and developers to innovate and distribute their agents. The live website is at https://app.aios.foundation, the code is at https://github.com/agiresearch/Cerebrum, and video is at https://app.aios.foundation/video-demo.
papers.summary_en: Cerebrum is an Agent SDK for AIOS that provides a unified platform for developing, deploying, distributing, and discovering LLM-based autonomous agents. It features a modular four-layer architecture, a community-driven Agent Hub with version control, and an interactive web interface for testing. The platform supports various agent architectures like CoT, ReAct, and tool-use agents, standardizing development while enabling flexibility and sharing.
papers.summary_zh: Cerebrum是AIOS的Agent SDK，为基于LLM的自主智能体提供了开发、部署、分发和发现的统一平台。它采用模块化的四层架构，包含社区驱动的智能体中心（支持版本控制和依赖管理）以及交互式网页测试界面。该平台支持CoT、ReAct和工具使用等多种智能体架构，在标准化开发流程的同时保持了灵活性和可共享性。

papers.title: Infogent: An Agent-Based Framework for Web Information Aggregation
papers.short_title: Infogent: Web Info Aggregation Framework
papers.abstract: Despite seemingly performant web agents on the task-completion benchmarks, most existing methods evaluate the agents based on a presupposition: the web navigation task consists of linear sequence of actions with an end state that marks task completion. In contrast, our work focuses on web navigation for information aggregation, wherein the agent must explore different websites to gather information for a complex query. We consider web information aggregation from two different perspectives: (i) Direct API-driven Access relies on a text-only view of the Web, leveraging external tools such as Google Search API to navigate the web and a scraper to extract website contents. (ii) Interactive Visual Access uses screenshots of the webpages and requires interaction with the browser to navigate and access information. Motivated by these diverse information access settings, we introduce Infogent, a novel modular framework for web information aggregation involving three distinct components: Navigator, Extractor and Aggregator. Experiments on different information access settings demonstrate Infogent beats an existing SOTA multi-agent search framework by 7% under Direct API-Driven Access on FRAMES, and improves over an existing information-seeking web agent by 4.3% under Interactive Visual Access on AssistantBench.
papers.summary_en: Infogent is a modular framework for web information aggregation that handles complex queries requiring exploration across multiple websites. It supports two access modes: direct API-driven access using text-only web views and interactive visual access using browser screenshots. The framework consists of three components—Navigator, Extractor, and Aggregator—and outperforms existing methods on FRAMES and AssistantBench benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh: Infogent是一个用于网络信息聚合的模块化框架，能够处理需要跨多个网站探索的复杂查询。它支持两种访问模式：基于API的直接访问（使用纯文本网页视图）和交互式视觉访问（使用浏览器截图）。该框架由导航器、提取器和聚合器三个组件组成，在FRAMES和AssistantBench基准测试上优于现有方法。

papers.title: Design2Code: Benchmarking Multimodal Code Generation for Automated Front-End Engineering
papers.short_title: Design2Code: Multimodal Code Gen for Front-End
papers.abstract: Generative AI has made rapid advancements in recent years, achieving unprecedented capabilities in multimodal understanding and code generation. This can enable a new paradigm of front-end development in which multimodal large language models (MLLMs) directly convert visual designs into code implementations. In this work, we construct Design2Code - the first real-world benchmark for this task. Specifically, we manually curate 484 diverse real-world webpages as test cases and develop a set of automatic evaluation metrics to assess how well current multimodal LLMs can generate the code implementations that directly render into the given reference webpages, given the screenshots as input. We also complement automatic metrics with comprehensive human evaluations to validate the performance ranking. To rigorously benchmark MLLMs, we test various multimodal prompting methods on frontier models such as GPT-4o, GPT-4V, Gemini, and Claude. Our fine-grained break-down metrics indicate that models mostly lag in recalling visual elements from the input webpages and generating correct layout designs.
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces Design2Code, the first real-world benchmark for converting webpage screenshots into code using multimodal LLMs. It includes 484 diverse webpages and automatic evaluation metrics, validated by human assessments. Tests on models like GPT-4o and Gemini reveal that they struggle with recalling visual elements and generating correct layouts.
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出了Design2Code，这是首个将网页截图转换为代码的真实世界基准测试。它包含484个多样化网页和自动评估指标，并通过人工评估验证。对GPT-4o、Gemini等模型的测试表明，它们在回忆视觉元素和生成正确布局方面存在不足。

papers.title: ALOHA: Empowering Multilingual Agent for University Orientation with Hierarchical Retrieval
papers.short_title: ALOHA: Multilingual Agent with Hierarchical Retrieval
papers.abstract: The rise of Large Language Models~(LLMs) revolutionizes information retrieval, allowing users to obtain required answers through complex instructions within conversations. However, publicly available services remain inadequate in addressing the needs of faculty and students to search campus-specific information. It is primarily due to the LLM's lack of domain-specific knowledge and the limitation of search engines in supporting multilingual and timely scenarios. To tackle these challenges, we introduce ALOHA, a multilingual agent enhanced by hierarchical retrieval for university orientation. We also integrate external APIs into the front-end interface to provide interactive service. The human evaluation and case study show our proposed system has strong capabilities to yield correct, timely, and user-friendly responses to the queries in multiple languages, surpassing commercial chatbots and search engines. The system has been deployed and has provided service for more than 12,000 people.
papers.summary_en: ALOHA is a multilingual agent for university orientation that uses hierarchical retrieval to overcome LLMs' lack of domain-specific knowledge and search engines' limitations in multilingual and timely scenarios. It integrates external APIs for interactive front-end services, and evaluations show it outperforms commercial chatbots and search engines in providing correct, timely, and user-friendly responses across multiple languages. The system has been deployed, serving over 12,000 users.
papers.summary_zh: ALOHA是一个面向大学迎新场景的多语言智能体，通过分层检索克服了大语言模型缺乏领域知识以及搜索引擎在多语言和时效性场景下的局限。该系统在前端集成了外部API以提供交互式服务，评估表明其在多语言查询的正确性、时效性和用户友好性方面均优于商业聊天机器人和搜索引擎。该系统已部署并服务了超过12,000人。

papers.title: Towards Reliable Agents: Benchmarking Customized LLM-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation Frameworks with Deployment Validation
papers.short_title: Reliable Agents: Benchmarking Customized RAG with Deployment Validation

papers.title: NAT: Enhancing Agent Tuning with Negative Samples
papers.short_title: NAT: Enhancing Agent Tuning with Negative Samples
papers.abstract: Interaction trajectories between agents and environments have proven effective in tuning LLMs into task-specific agents. However, constructing these trajectories, especially successful trajectories, is often computationally and time intensive due to the relatively low success rates of even the most advanced LLMs, such as GPT-4 and Claude. Additionally, common training paradigms like supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) not only require large volumes of data but also have specific demands regarding the trajectories used. For instance, existing SFT approaches typically utilize only positive examples, limiting their efficiency in low-resource scenarios. To address this, we introduce Negative-Aware Training (NAT), a straightforward yet effective method that leverages both successful and failed trajectories for fine-tuning, maximizing the utility of limited resources. Experimental results demonstrate that NAT consistently surpasses existing methods, including SFT, DPO, and PPO, across various tasks 1 .
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces Negative-Aware Training (NAT), a method that fine-tunes LLMs into task-specific agents using both successful and failed interaction trajectories. Unlike standard supervised fine-tuning which only uses positive examples, NAT leverages negative samples to improve data efficiency, especially when successful trajectories are scarce. Experiments show NAT outperforms SFT, DPO, and PPO across various tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness in low-resource settings.
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出负样本感知训练（NAT），一种利用成功和失败交互轨迹微调LLM为任务型智能体的方法。与仅使用正例的标准监督微调不同，NAT通过利用负样本提升数据效率，尤其在成功轨迹稀缺时效果显著。实验表明，NAT在多种任务上优于SFT、DPO和PPO，证明了其在低资源场景下的有效性。

papers.title: Adapting LLM Agents with Universal Communication Feedback
papers.short_title: Adapting LLM Agents with Universal Communication Feedback
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces a universal communication feedback mechanism to adapt large language model (LLM) agents across diverse tasks. The approach leverages a shared feedback interface that allows agents to learn from task-agnostic signals, improving their performance without requiring task-specific training. Experiments demonstrate that the method enhances agent adaptability and efficiency in multi-turn interactions, outperforming baselines on several benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种通用通信反馈机制，用于在不同任务中自适应调整大语言模型（LLM）智能体。该方法利用共享的反馈接口，使智能体能够从与任务无关的信号中学习，从而无需针对特定任务进行训练即可提升性能。实验表明，该方法增强了智能体在多轮交互中的适应性和效率，在多个基准测试中优于基线模型。

papers.title: ReachAgent: Enhancing Mobile Agent via Page Reaching and Operation
papers.short_title: ReachAgent: Mobile Agent via Page Reaching & Operation
papers.abstract: Recently, mobile AI agents have gained increasing attention. Given a task, mobile AI agents can interact with mobile devices in multiple steps and finally form a GUI flow that solves the task. However, existing agents tend to focus on most task-relevant elements at each step, leading to local optimal solutions and ignoring the overall GUI flow. To address this issue, we constructed a training dataset called MobileReach, which breaks the task into page reaching and operation subtasks. Furthermore, we propose ReachAgent, a two-stage framework that focuses on improving its task-completion abilities. It utilizes the page reaching and page operation subtasks, along with reward-based preference GUI flows, to further enhance the agent. Experimental results show that ReachAgent significantly improves the IoU Acc and Text Acc by 7.12% and 7.69% on the step-level and 4.72% and 4.63% on the task-level compared to the SOTA agent. Our data and code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_en: ReachAgent is a two-stage framework for mobile AI agents that decomposes tasks into page reaching and operation subtasks, using a new dataset MobileReach and reward-based preference learning to improve global GUI flow planning. It outperforms state-of-the-art agents by over 7% in step-level accuracy and over 4% in task-level accuracy.
papers.summary_zh: ReachAgent是一个两阶段移动AI代理框架，将任务分解为页面到达和操作子任务，利用新数据集MobileReach和基于奖励的偏好学习来改进全局GUI流程规划。它在步骤级准确率上比最先进代理提升超过7%，在任务级准确率上提升超过4%。

papers.title: TurkingBench: A Challenge Benchmark for Web Agents
papers.short_title: TurkingBench: A Challenge Benchmark for Web Agents

papers.title: MMAU: A Holistic Benchmark of Agent Capabilities Across Diverse Domains
papers.short_title: MMAU: Agent Benchmark
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have increased the demand for comprehensive benchmarks to evaluate their capabilities as human-like agents. Existing benchmarks, while useful, often focus on specific application scenarios, emphasizing task completion but failing to dissect the underlying skills that drive these outcomes. This lack of granularity makes it difficult to deeply discern where failures stem from. Additionally, setting up these environments requires considerable effort, and issues of unreliability and reproducibility sometimes arise, especially in interactive tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce the Massive Multitask Agent Understanding (MMAU) benchmark, featuring comprehensive offline tasks that eliminate the need for complex environment setups. It evaluates models across five domains, including Tool-use, Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) QA, Data Science and Machine Learning coding, Contest-level programming and Mathematics, and covers five essential capabilities: Understanding, Reasoning, Planning, Problem-solving, and Self-correction. With a total of 20 meticulously designed tasks encompassing over 3K distinct prompts, MMAU provides a comprehensive framework for evaluating the strengths and limitations of LLM agents. By testing 18 representative models on MMAU, we provide deep and insightful analyses. Ultimately, MMAU not only sheds light on the capabilities and limitations of LLM agents but also enhances the interpretability of their performance. Datasets and evaluation scripts of MMAU are released at https://github.com/apple/axlearn/tree/main/docs/research/mmau.
papers.summary_en: The paper introduces MMAU, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents across five domains and five core capabilities using over 3,000 offline prompts, eliminating the need for complex environment setups. It tests 18 models, providing insights into their strengths and limitations in tasks like tool use, coding, and reasoning. The benchmark aims to improve interpretability and reproducibility in agent evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: 该论文提出了MMAU基准，通过超过3000个离线提示，在五个领域和五种核心能力上评估LLM智能体，无需复杂环境搭建。它测试了18个模型，揭示了它们在工具使用、编程和推理等任务中的优势与局限。该基准旨在提升智能体评估的可解释性和可重复性。

papers.title: UFO: A UI-Focused Agent for Windows OS Interaction
papers.short_title: UFO: A UI-Focused Agent for Windows OS Interaction
papers.abstract: We introduce UFO, an innovative UI-Focused agent to fulfill user requests tailored to applications on Windows OS, harnessing the capabilities of GPT-Vision. UFO employs a dual-agent framework to meticulously observe and analyze the graphical user interface (GUI) and control information of Windows applications. This enables the agent to seamlessly navigate and operate within individual applications and across them to fulfill user requests, even when spanning multiple applications. The framework incorporates a control interaction module, facilitating action grounding without human intervention and enabling fully automated execution. Consequently, UFO transforms arduous and time-consuming processes into simple tasks achievable solely through natural language commands. We conducted testing of UFO across 9 popular Windows applications, encompassing a variety of scenarios reflective of users' daily usage. The results, derived from both quantitative metrics and real-case studies, underscore the superior effectiveness of UFO in fulfilling user requests. To the best of our knowledge, UFO stands as the first UI agent specifically tailored for task completion within the Windows OS environment. The open-source code for UFO is available on https://github.com/microsoft/UFO.
papers.summary_en: UFO is a UI-focused agent for Windows OS that uses GPT-Vision and a dual-agent framework to observe and interact with graphical interfaces, enabling automated task completion across multiple applications via natural language commands. It outperforms baselines in tests on 9 popular Windows apps, and is the first such agent tailored for Windows.
papers.summary_zh: UFO是一个面向Windows操作系统的UI聚焦代理，利用GPT-Vision和双代理框架观察并操作图形界面，通过自然语言命令实现跨多个应用的自动化任务完成。在9个流行Windows应用的测试中，它优于基线方法，并且是首个专为Windows环境设计的此类代理。

papers.title: xLAM: A Family of Large Action Models to Empower AI Agent Systems
papers.short_title: xLAM: Large Action Models
papers.abstract: Autonomous agents powered by large language models (LLMs) have attracted significant research interest. However, the open-source community faces many challenges in developing specialized models for agent tasks, driven by the scarcity of high-quality agent datasets and the absence of standard protocols in this area. We introduce and publicly release xLAM, a series of large action models designed for AI agent tasks. The xLAM series includes five models with both dense and mixture-of-expert architectures, ranging from 1B to 8x22B parameters, trained using a scalable, flexible pipeline that unifies, augments, and synthesizes diverse datasets to enhance AI agents' generalizability and performance across varied environments. Our experimental results demonstrate that xLAM consistently delivers exceptional performance across multiple agent ability benchmarks, notably securing the 1st position on the Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard, outperforming GPT-4, Claude-3, and many other models in terms of tool use. By releasing the xLAM series, we aim to advance the performance of open-source LLMs for autonomous AI agents, potentially accelerating progress and democratizing access to high-performance models for agent tasks. Models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/Salesforce/xlam-models-65f00e2a0a63bbcd1c2dade4
papers.summary_en: The paper introduces xLAM, a family of large language models specifically designed for AI agent tasks, ranging from 1B to 8x22B parameters with dense and mixture-of-expert architectures. These models are trained using a scalable pipeline that unifies, augments, and synthesizes diverse datasets to improve generalization and performance. xLAM achieves state-of-the-art results on agent benchmarks, including 1st place on the Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard, outperforming GPT-4 and Claude-3 in tool use. The release aims to advance open-source LLMs for autonomous agents and democratize access to high-performance agent models.
papers.summary_zh: 本文介绍了xLAM系列模型，专为AI智能体任务设计，参数规模从1B到8x22B，包含密集和混合专家架构。这些模型通过可扩展的流水线训练，该流水线统一、增强并合成多样化数据集，以提升泛化能力和性能。xLAM在多个智能体能力基准测试中取得领先结果，尤其在伯克利函数调用排行榜上位列第一，在工具使用方面超越GPT-4和Claude-3。该系列的发布旨在推动开源大语言模型在自主智能体领域的发展，并促进高性能智能体模型的普及。

papers.title: LiteWebAgent: The Open-Source Suite for VLM-Based Web-Agent Applications
papers.short_title: LiteWebAgent: VLM Web-Agent Suite
papers.abstract: We introduce LiteWebAgent, an open-source suite for VLM-based web agent applications. Our framework addresses a critical gap in the web agent ecosystem with a production-ready solution that combines minimal serverless backend configuration, intuitive user and browser interfaces, and extensible research capabilities in agent planning, memory, and tree search. For the core LiteWebAgent agent framework, we implemented a simple yet effective baseline using recursive function calling, providing with decoupled action generation and action grounding. In addition, we integrate advanced research components such as agent planning, agent workflow memory, and tree search in a modular and extensible manner. We then integrate the LiteWebAgent agent framework with frontend and backend as deployed systems in two formats: (1) a production Vercel-based web application, which provides users with an agent-controlled remote browser, (2) a Chrome extension leveraging LiteWebAgent's API to control an existing Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol). The LiteWebAgent framework is available at https://github.com/PathOnAI/LiteWebAgent, with deployed frontend at https://lite-web-agent.vercel.app/.
papers.summary_en: LiteWebAgent is an open-source suite for building web agents powered by vision-language models (VLMs). It provides a production-ready system with a minimal serverless backend, intuitive user interfaces, and modular support for advanced research features like agent planning, memory, and tree search. The framework includes a baseline agent using recursive function calling with decoupled action generation and grounding, and is deployed as both a Vercel-based web application and a Chrome extension. This work fills a gap in the web agent ecosystem by offering a practical, extensible platform for both deployment and research.
papers.summary_zh: LiteWebAgent是一个基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的Web智能体开源套件。它提供了生产级系统，包含极简的无服务器后端配置、直观的用户界面，以及模块化的高级研究功能（如智能体规划、记忆和树搜索）。该框架采用递归函数调用实现基线智能体，将动作生成与动作执行解耦，并部署为基于Vercel的Web应用和Chrome扩展两种形式。这项工作填补了Web智能体生态系统的空白，为部署和研究提供了实用且可扩展的平台。

papers.title: MobA: Multifaceted Memory-Enhanced Adaptive Planning for Efficient Mobile Task Automation
papers.short_title: MobA: Memory-Enhanced Mobile Planning
papers.abstract: Existing Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based agents face significant challenges in handling complex GUI (Graphical User Interface) interactions on devices. These challenges arise from the dynamic and structured nature of GUI environments, which integrate text, images, and spatial relationships, as well as the variability in action spaces across different pages and tasks. To address these limitations, we propose MobA, a novel MLLM-based mobile assistant system. MobA introduces an adaptive planning module that incorporates a reflection mechanism for error recovery and dynamically adjusts plans to align with the real environment contexts and action module's execution capacity. Additionally, a multifaceted memory module provides comprehensive memory support to enhance adaptability and efficiency. We also present MobBench, a dataset designed for complex mobile interactions. Experimental results on MobBench and AndroidArena demonstrate MobA's ability to handle dynamic GUI environments and perform complex mobile tasks.
papers.summary_en: MobA is a novel mobile assistant system based on Multimodal Large Language Models that addresses challenges in dynamic GUI environments through an adaptive planning module with reflection-based error recovery and a multifaceted memory module. It dynamically adjusts plans to match real-world contexts and action capabilities, and introduces MobBench, a benchmark for complex mobile tasks. Experiments show MobA effectively handles dynamic interfaces and performs complex operations.
papers.summary_zh: MobA是一种基于多模态大语言模型的新型移动助手系统，通过引入带反射机制的适应性规划模块和多面记忆模块，解决了动态GUI环境中的挑战。它能动态调整计划以匹配真实环境上下文和动作执行能力，并提出了用于复杂移动任务的基准MobBench。实验表明，MobA能有效处理动态界面并执行复杂操作。

papers.title: Hephaestus: Improving Fundamental Agent Capabilities of Large Language Models through Continual Pre-Training
papers.short_title: Hephaestus: Continual Pre-Training for Agents
papers.abstract: Due to the scarcity of agent-oriented pre-training data, LLM-based autonomous agents typically rely on complex prompting or extensive fine-tuning, which often fails to introduce new capabilities while preserving strong generalizability. We introduce Hephaestus-Forge, the first large-scale pre-training corpus designed to enhance the fundamental capabilities of LLM agents in API function calling, intrinsic reasoning and planning, and adapting to environmental feedback. Hephaestus-Forge comprises 103B agent-specific data encompassing 76,537 APIs, including both tool documentation to introduce knowledge of API functions and function calling trajectories to strengthen intrinsic reasoning. To explore effective training protocols, we investigate scaling laws to identify the optimal recipe in data mixing ratios. By continual pre-training on Hephaestus-Forge, Hephaestus outperforms small- to medium-scale open-source LLMs and rivals commercial LLMs on three agent benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of our pre-training corpus in enhancing fundamental agentic capabilities and generalization of LLMs to new tasks or environments.
papers.summary_en: The paper introduces Hephaestus-Forge, a large-scale pre-training corpus with 103B tokens covering 76,537 APIs, designed to enhance LLMs' fundamental agent capabilities like function calling, reasoning, and planning. Through continual pre-training on this corpus, the resulting model Hephaestus outperforms small-to-medium open-source LLMs and rivals commercial models on agent benchmarks, demonstrating improved generalization to new tasks and environments.
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出了Hephaestus-Forge，一个包含103B token和76,537个API的大规模预训练语料库，旨在增强LLM在函数调用、推理和规划等基础智能体能力。通过在该语料库上进行持续预训练，得到的Hephaestus模型在智能体基准测试中超越了中小型开源LLM，并可与商业模型媲美，展示了在新任务和环境中的泛化能力提升。

papers.title: Program Guided Agent
papers.short_title: Program Guided Agent
papers.abstract: Developing agents that can learn to follow natural language instructions has been an emerging research direction. While being accessible and flexible, natural language instructions can sometimes be ambiguous even to humans. To address this, we propose to utilize programs, structured in a formal language, as a precise and expressive way to specify tasks. We then devise a modular framework that learns to perform a task specified by a program – as different circumstances give rise to diverse ways to accomplish the task, our framework can perceive which circumstance it is currently under, and instruct a multitask policy accordingly to fulfill each subtask of the overall task. Experimental results on a 2D Minecraft environment not only demonstrate that the proposed framework learns to reliably accomplish program instructions and achieves zero-shot generalization to more complex instructions but also verify the efficiency of the proposed modulation mechanism for learning the multitask policy. We also conduct an analysis comparing various models which learn from programs and natural language instructions in an end-to-end fashion.
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces a framework that uses formal programs instead of natural language to specify tasks for AI agents, addressing ambiguity in instructions. The agent learns to perceive its current situation and modulate a multitask policy to execute each subtask of the program. Experiments in a 2D Minecraft environment show reliable task completion, zero-shot generalization to more complex programs, and efficient learning of the multitask policy.
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出一种框架，使用形式化程序而非自然语言来指定AI智能体的任务，以解决指令歧义问题。智能体学习感知当前情境，并调节多任务策略以执行程序的每个子任务。在2D Minecraft环境中的实验表明，该框架能可靠完成任务，零样本泛化到更复杂的程序，并高效学习多任务策略。

application_domain:code-agent.en: This category covers research on AI agents that autonomously perform software engineering tasks, such as code generation, bug fixing, test creation, and interacting with development environments. Typical goals include automating repetitive coding tasks, improving software quality, and enabling natural language-driven software development. Methods include multi-agent collaboration, reinforcement learning from trajectories, and integrating code execution with planning.
application_domain:code-agent.zh: 该类别涵盖自主执行软件工程任务的AI智能体研究，例如代码生成、缺陷修复、测试创建以及与开发环境交互。典型目标包括自动化重复性编码任务、提高软件质量以及实现自然语言驱动的软件开发。常用方法包括多智能体协作、从轨迹中进行强化学习以及将代码执行与规划相结合。

metadata.trends: Recent trend emphasizes training agents with real-world software engineering tasks and scaling data or inference time for improved performance.

application_domain:code-agent/test-gener.en: This category focuses on using LLM-based code agents to automatically generate test cases from natural language descriptions of software issues. Key methods include transforming issue reports into executable tests, often as a means to validate bug fixes and improve code repair systems. Research in this area involves benchmarking on real-world repositories (e.g., SWT-Bench) and analyzing metrics like issue reproduction rate and coverage change. A recent trend is leveraging generated tests as formal specifications to filter and enhance code repair proposals.
application_domain:code-agent/test-gener.zh: 该类别专注于使用基于LLM的代码代理从软件问题的自然语言描述中自动生成测试用例。主要方法包括将问题报告转化为可执行的测试，通常用于验证错误修复并改进代码修复系统。该方向的研究涉及在真实仓库（如SWT-Bench）上进行基准测试，并分析问题复现率和覆盖率变化等指标。近期趋势是利用生成的测试作为形式化规范来过滤和增强代码修复提案。

metadata.trends: Leveraging code agents to generate tests as formal specifications for boosting code repair effectiveness.

application_domain:creative-agent.en: This category covers research on AI agents that automate or assist in creative design tasks such as UI/UX design, graphic design, image retouching, 3D scene synthesis, and presentation generation. These agents typically leverage large language models (LLMs) or vision-language models (VLMs) to understand user intent, plan sequences of actions, invoke design tools, and iteratively refine outputs. Tasks involve converting sketches or descriptions into functional prototypes, restoring degraded images, composing 3D scenes, or generating presentation videos. The goal is to lower the barrier for non-experts and accelerate the design workflow through intelligent, autonomous, and interactive agents.
application_domain:creative-agent.zh: 该类研究关注能够自动化或辅助创意设计任务的AI智能体，例如UI/UX设计、图形设计、图像修图、3D场景合成和演示文稿生成。这些智能体通常利用大语言模型（LLM）或视觉语言模型（VLM）来理解用户意图、规划行动序列、调用设计工具并迭代优化输出结果。典型任务包括将草图或描述转换为功能原型、修复退化图像、构建3D场景或生成演讲视频。其目标是通过智能、自主且交互式的智能体，降低非专业用户的使用门槛并加速设计工作流程。

methods: Large Language Models (LLMs) for planning and reasoning
metadata.trends: Recent trend is moving towards more autonomous and interactive agents that can proactively ask clarifying questions, learn user preferences over time, and generalize across multiple creative domains with minimal human intervention.

application_domain:.en: This dimension categorizes AI agents based on their primary application domain or operational environment. The organizing principle is the specific context in which the agent is deployed, such as coding assistance, creative work, desktop automation, or physical embodiment. It aims to structure research by focusing on domain-specific challenges, capabilities, and design considerations unique to each setting.
application_domain:.zh: 该维度根据人工智能代理的主要应用领域或运行环境对其进行分类。组织原则是代理部署的特定场景，如代码辅助、创意工作、桌面自动化或具身实体。它旨在通过关注每个场景独特的领域特定挑战、能力和设计考虑来组织研究。

application_domain:code-agent/code-repai.en: This category focuses on using language model agents to automatically repair software bugs and implement new features in real-world codebases. Core methods include designing agent-computer interfaces (ACIs) for efficient repository navigation and code editing, training agents via supervised fine-tuning or reinforcement learning on execution feedback, and leveraging generated test cases to validate proposed fixes. Key challenges are achieving high resolution rates on diverse, complex tasks and ensuring reliable performance across different software projects. It is distinct from general code generation by emphasizing iterative, interactive repair within existing codebases.
application_domain:code-agent/code-repai.zh: 该类别专注于使用语言模型代理自动修复软件漏洞并在真实代码库中实现新功能。核心方法包括设计代理-计算机接口（ACI）以高效导航仓库和编辑代码、通过执行反馈进行监督微调或强化学习训练代理，以及利用生成的测试用例验证提出的修复方案。主要挑战是在多样化的复杂任务上实现高解决率，并确保跨不同软件项目的可靠性能。与通用代码生成不同，它强调在现有代码库中进行迭代、交互式的修复。

methods: Test generation for validation and filtering
metadata.trends: The field is shifting from static prompting to training specialized SWE agents with self-play or verifier-guided inference-time scaling, aiming for more reliable and autonomous software repair.

application_domain:desktop-agent.en: Desktop-agent research focuses on creating autonomous software agents that operate on desktop graphical user interfaces (GUIs) to perform complex, multi-step tasks such as UI testing, bug reproduction, document workflow automation, and general computer use. These agents leverage techniques like multimodal large language models (MLLMs), computer vision, and reinforcement learning to perceive screen content, ground natural language instructions, and plan actions. Key challenges include handling dynamic interfaces, long-horizon planning, and ensuring security and robustness against out-of-distribution inputs. The goal is to enable agents that can interact with any desktop application as efficiently as a human user.
application_domain:desktop-agent.zh: 桌面智能体研究专注于创建在桌面图形用户界面（GUI）上自主运行的软件智能体，以完成复杂的多步骤任务，如UI测试、缺陷复现、文档工作流自动化和通用计算机操作。这些智能体利用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）、计算机视觉和强化学习等技术来感知屏幕内容、理解自然语言指令并规划行动。关键挑战包括处理动态界面、长期规划以及确保对分布外输入的鲁棒性和安全性。目标是使智能体能够像人类用户一样高效地与任何桌面应用程序交互。

metadata.trends: Recent trend is the shift towards end-to-end learning with large multimodal models and reinforcement learning, enabling more generalizable and autonomous desktop agents, along with creation of large-scale trajectory datasets to improve training.

application_domain:desktop-agent/gui-app.en: This category focuses on developing autonomous GUI agents that interact with desktop applications using computer vision and natural language understanding. Research emphasizes techniques like visual grounding, hierarchical planning, and reinforcement learning to enable agents to perform complex multi-step tasks such as form filling, document editing, and cross-platform interaction. Key challenges include robust semantic alignment, out-of-distribution detection, and long-horizon task execution.
application_domain:desktop-agent/gui-app.zh: 该类别专注于开发能够通过计算机视觉和自然语言理解与桌面应用程序交互的自主GUI智能体。研究强调视觉定位、分层规划和强化学习等技术，使智能体能够执行复杂的多步骤任务，如表单填写、文档编辑和跨平台交互。关键挑战包括鲁棒的语义对齐、分布外检测以及长周期任务执行。

methods: Visual grounding with multimodal large language models
metadata.trends: Recent trends focus on building generalist GUI agents that work across multiple platforms (desktop, mobile, web) with improved semantic understanding and long-horizon reasoning, often leveraging synthetic data generation and self-supervised learning from web tutorials.

application_domain:creative-agent/conten.en: This category focuses on using autonomous agents, powered by large language models (LLMs) or vision-language models (VLMs), to generate rich multimedia content such as images, 3D scenes, charts, and presentation videos. Typical tasks include semantic image retouching, chart question answering, 3D scene synthesis from text, multi-degradation image restoration, and document-to-presentation video generation. Core methods involve agent-based planning, tool integration, iterative refinement, and memory mechanisms to handle complex, multi-step content creation workflows. The key distinction from sibling categories is the emphasis on autonomous decision-making and orchestration of multiple generative or editing modules to achieve user-specified goals.
application_domain:creative-agent/conten.zh: 该类别聚焦于利用大语言模型（LLM）或视觉语言模型（VLM）驱动的自主智能体，生成丰富的多媒体内容，如图像、3D场景、图表和演示视频。典型任务包括语义图像修图、图表问答、文本到3D场景合成、多退化图像恢复以及文档到演示视频生成。核心方法涉及基于智能体的规划、工具集成、迭代优化和记忆机制，以处理复杂的多步骤内容生成工作流。与同级类别的关键区别在于强调自主决策和对多个生成或编辑模块的编排，以实现用户指定的目标。

methods: LLM agent for programmatic solution reasoning
Scene graph planning and Python script generation
Modular agent with task planning and model selection
metadata.trends: Recent works shift from single-task generative models to autonomous agents that combine planning, tool use, and iterative refinement for complex, multi-step content generation.

application_domain:embodied-agent.en: Embodied-agent research focuses on creating intelligent agents that perceive, reason, and act within physical or simulated environments. Typical tasks include vision-and-language navigation, robotic manipulation, game testing, and virtual sensor data generation. Researchers leverage large language models, reinforcement learning, and hierarchical planning to enable agents to follow instructions, explore environments, and interact with objects. The goal is to develop agents that can generalize across diverse scenarios and perform complex, long-horizon tasks safely and efficiently.
application_domain:embodied-agent.zh: 具身智能体研究致力于创建能够感知、推理并在物理或模拟环境中行动的智能体。典型任务包括视觉语言导航、机器人操作、游戏测试和虚拟传感器数据生成。研究人员利用大语言模型、强化学习和分层规划，使智能体能够遵循指令、探索环境并与物体交互。目标是开发能够跨多种场景泛化、安全高效地执行复杂长周期任务的智能体。

metadata.trends: Increasing integration of large language models and vision-language models as core reasoning engines for embodied agents, with a focus on zero-shot generalization, safety, and long-horizon planning.

application_domain:code-agent/code-gener.en: This category focuses on using multiple interacting LLM agents to autonomously generate code for complex software engineering tasks. Rather than single-step prompting, research here develops multi-agent frameworks that emulate human software processes—such as planning, coding, testing, and debugging—through role-playing and structured communication. Core methods include agent orchestration (e.g., orchestrator-worker), iterative refinement with execution feedback, and the use of agent-computer interfaces (ACI) to navigate codebases and run tests. Key challenges are ensuring functional correctness, handling long contexts, and coordinating specialized agent roles. This direction is distinct for its emphasis on autonomous, multi-step code generation that mimics real-world development workflows, often evaluated on benchmarks like HumanEval, MBPP, and SWE-Bench.
application_domain:code-agent/code-gener.zh: 该类别聚焦于利用多个交互式大语言模型智能体自主完成复杂软件工程的代码生成。与单步提示不同，该方向研究开发多智能体框架，通过角色扮演和结构化通信来模拟人类软件流程（如规划、编码、测试和调试）。核心方法包括智能体编排（如编排者-工作者模式）、基于执行反馈的迭代优化，以及使用智能体-计算机界面导航代码库并运行测试。主要挑战在于确保功能正确性、处理长上下文以及协调专门化智能体的角色。该方向的独特之处在于强调自主、多步的代码生成，模拟真实开发工作流，并常在HumanEval、MBPP和SWE-Bench等基准上评估。

metadata.trends: The field is evolving from simple single-agent code generation to sophisticated multi-agent systems that interact with real-world environments, incorporate self-improvement through training, and address safety and reliability in autonomous software engineering.

application_domain:creative-agent/design.en: This category focuses on AI agents that assist in design tasks, such as UI/UX design, graphic design, and image retouching. Typical methods involve large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) that interpret natural language prompts, retrieve design examples, and generate or modify visual outputs. Core challenges include understanding ambiguous user intent, maintaining design consistency, and generating high-fidelity prototypes.
application_domain:creative-agent/design.zh: 该类别聚焦于辅助设计任务的AI智能体，例如UI/UX设计、平面设计和图像修饰。典型方法包括使用大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）解读自然语言提示、检索设计示例，并生成或修改视觉输出。核心挑战包括理解模糊的用户意图、保持设计一致性以及生成高保真原型。

metadata.trends: Recent trend is using large multimodal models as agents to interact with design tools and iteratively refine designs based on user feedback.

application_domain:code-agent/repo-level.en: This category focuses on AI agents that operate at the level of entire code repositories, understanding complex codebases, resolving real-world software issues, and autonomously executing tasks such as setting up environments, running experiments, and fixing bugs. Typical methods include using large language models to generate executable code actions, navigating repositories via command line or web interfaces, coordinating multiple specialized agents, and integrating with sandboxed environments for safe code execution. The goal is to build generalist or specialized agents capable of performing software engineering tasks that traditionally require human expertise, such as debugging, testing, and implementing new features.
application_domain:code-agent/repo-level.zh: 该类别专注于在完整代码仓库层面运行的AI智能体，它们需要理解复杂的代码库、解决真实的软件问题，并自主完成环境搭建、实验执行和Bug修复等任务。典型方法包括使用大语言模型生成可执行代码动作、通过命令行或网页界面导航仓库、协调多个专业智能体协作，以及集成沙箱环境进行安全代码执行。目标在于构建能够执行传统上需要人类专业知识的软件工程任务（如调试、测试和实现新功能）的通才或专才型智能体。

methods: Large language model agent with code execution
Sandboxed environment for safe code execution
metadata.trends: The field is evolving from single-agent approaches to multi-agent systems that leverage diverse expertise and collaborative problem-solving, with increasing emphasis on benchmarking real-world software engineering tasks and supporting flexible action spaces through executable code.

application_domain:mobile-agent.en: Mobile-agent research focuses on developing automated testing and analysis techniques for mobile applications, including GUI testing, acceptance test generation, and UI automation. Typical tasks include exploring app interfaces to detect bugs, generating test scripts from natural language descriptions, and using robotic arms or LLMs to simulate user interactions. The goal is to reduce manual effort, improve test coverage, and find compatibility or functional issues efficiently.
application_domain:mobile-agent.zh: 移动代理研究专注于开发移动应用的自动化测试和分析技术，包括图形用户界面（GUI）测试、验收测试生成和用户界面（UI）自动化。典型任务包括探索应用界面以检测缺陷、从自然语言描述生成测试脚本，以及使用机械臂或大语言模型（LLM）模拟用户交互。目标在于减少人工工作、提高测试覆盖率，并高效发现兼容性或功能性问题。

methods: UI element grouping using multimodal learning
metadata.trends: Recent trend is leveraging large language models (LLMs) and retrieval-augmented generation to automate mobile testing, reduce cost, and enable non-intrusive testing across diverse platforms and device types.

application_domain:desktop-agent/os-leve.en: This research category focuses on developing autonomous agents that control computer operating systems at a low level, typically through GUI interactions (mouse and keyboard) or system APIs. Core methods include multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for screen understanding and action planning, hierarchical planning with experience augmentation, and real-time security auditing to prevent harmful operations. Key challenges involve handling dynamic, non-uniform interfaces, ensuring reliable execution across diverse applications, and maintaining security against emergent threats. The goal is to create generalist agents that can perform complex, multi-step tasks across various desktop environments without human intervention.
application_domain:desktop-agent/os-leve.zh: 该研究类别专注于开发能够以低级方式控制计算机操作系统的自主智能体，通常通过图形用户界面交互（鼠标和键盘）或系统API。核心方法包括用于屏幕理解和动作规划的多模态大语言模型、带有经验增强的分层规划，以及用于防止有害操作的实时安全审计。主要挑战包括处理动态、非统一的界面，确保跨不同应用的可靠执行，以及抵御新兴威胁的安全性。目标是创建能够在各种桌面环境中无需人工干预即可执行复杂多步任务的通用型智能体。

metadata.trends: The field is evolving from specialized, task-specific agents toward generalist OS-level agents that emphasize security, scalability, and cross-platform generalization.

application_domain:mobile-agent/android-.en: This category covers research on automated GUI testing and interaction for Android applications, often using large language models (LLMs) or robotic systems to simulate human-like testing. Typical methods include LLM-driven question-answering for GUI exploration, retrieval-augmented generation for task decomposition, visual-based robotic arms for non-intrusive testing, and multimodal learning for UI element grouping. The goal is to improve testing coverage, detect bugs, and reduce manual effort.
application_domain:mobile-agent/android-.zh: 该类别涵盖针对Android应用的自动GUI测试和交互研究，通常利用大型语言模型（LLM）或机器人系统模拟类人测试。典型方法包括LLM驱动的问答式GUI探索、基于检索增强生成的任务分解、基于视觉的机械臂非侵入式测试以及多模态学习进行UI元素分组。目标是提高测试覆盖率、检测缺陷并减少人工成本。

metadata.trends: Recent trend is integrating LLMs and retrieval mechanisms to enhance GUI automation and testing, aiming for more adaptive and cost-effective solutions.

application_domain:mobile-agent/ios-nati.en: This category focuses on developing autonomous agents that operate on iOS mobile devices by directly perceiving and interacting with graphical user interfaces (GUIs) through vision-based methods, without relying on platform-specific metadata or APIs. Typical tasks include following natural language instructions to perform multi-step operations across apps, such as information seeking, form filling, and navigation. Core methods involve multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for visual grounding, chain-of-action planning, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to reduce hallucinations. Key challenges include handling dynamic UI layouts, long-horizon task execution, and cross-app coordination.
application_domain:mobile-agent/ios-nati.zh: 该类别专注于开发在iOS移动设备上自主操作的智能体，通过直接感知和交互图形用户界面（GUI）的视觉方法，而不依赖平台特定的元数据或API。典型任务包括遵循自然语言指令执行跨应用的多步骤操作，如信息搜索、表单填写和导航。核心方法涉及多模态大语言模型（MLLM）进行视觉定位、动作链规划以及检索增强生成（RAG）以减少幻觉。主要挑战包括处理动态UI布局、长周期任务执行以及跨应用协调。

metadata.trends: Recent trend is moving from reactive action generation to proactive planning with error recovery, and from single-app to multi-app long-horizon tasks using hierarchical agents and retrieval augmentation.

application_domain:embodied-agent/vision.en: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) research focuses on developing embodied agents that can follow natural language instructions to navigate in complex 3D environments. Core methods include using large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) for reasoning, visual prompting for spatially grounded guidance, hierarchical planning for sequential multi-task navigation, and test-time adaptation for online robustness. Key challenges involve handling language ambiguity, spatial reasoning, generalization to unseen scenes, and balancing inference efficiency with accuracy. This category is distinct from other embodied agent directions by its emphasis on cross-modal understanding between language and visual observations during sequential decision-making.
application_domain:embodied-agent/vision.zh: 视觉语言导航（VLN）研究专注于开发能够根据自然语言指令在复杂三维环境中导航的具身智能体。核心方法包括利用大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）进行推理、视觉提示用于空间引导、分层规划处理序列多任务导航，以及测试时自适应增强在线鲁棒性。主要挑战涉及处理语言歧义、空间推理、对新场景的泛化能力，以及平衡推理效率与准确性。该类别与其他具身智能体方向的区别在于强调在序列决策过程中语言与视觉观测之间的跨模态理解。

metadata.trends: Recent works increasingly leverage large language models and multimodal models to improve generalization and reasoning, while also addressing efficiency and adaptation to dynamic environments.

application_domain:embodied-agent/robot-.en: Robot manipulation research focuses on enabling robots to physically interact with objects and environments to perform tasks such as grasping, rearranging, and assembly. This category typically uses vision-language models (VLMs) or large language models (LLMs) for high-level planning, and reinforcement learning or imitation learning for low-level control. Key challenges include handling long-horizon tasks, generalizing to novel objects/scenes, and ensuring safety during interaction. Recent work emphasizes leveraging foundation models for zero-shot or few-shot adaptation, and integrating uncertainty awareness to align robot behavior with user intent.
application_domain:embodied-agent/robot-.zh: 机器人操控研究致力于使机器人能够与物体和环境进行物理交互，完成抓取、重新排列和组装等任务。该领域通常使用视觉-语言模型（VLM）或大型语言模型（LLM）进行高层规划，并结合强化学习或模仿学习进行底层控制。主要挑战包括处理长周期任务、泛化到新物体/场景以及确保交互过程中的安全性。近期研究强调利用基础模型实现零样本或小样本适应，并整合不确定性感知以使机器人行为与用户意图对齐。

metadata.trends: Recent work is shifting from purely high-level semantic planning to fine-grained action generation, leveraging foundation models for generalization, and incorporating uncertainty estimation and safety constraints to enable reliable real-world deployment.

application_domain:embodied-agent/game-p.en: This category covers research on AI agents designed to play complex games—such as Minecraft, text-based adventures, and strategy games—by leveraging large language models (LLMs) or vision-language models (VLMs). Typical tasks include long-horizon planning, open-ended exploration, and multi-step reasoning in partially observable environments. Common methods involve Monte Carlo tree search, reinforcement learning, imitation learning, retrieval-augmented generation, and memory-based architectures for decision-making. The goal is to build generalist agents that can adapt to new games or scenarios without task-specific retraining.
application_domain:embodied-agent/game-p.zh: 该类别涵盖基于大语言模型（LLM）或视觉语言模型（VLM）的智能体研究，旨在玩复杂游戏（如《我的世界》、文字冒险游戏和策略游戏）。典型任务包括长周期规划、开放式探索以及部分可观测环境下的多步推理。常用方法包括蒙特卡洛树搜索、强化学习、模仿学习、检索增强生成以及基于记忆的决策架构。其目标是构建能够无需任务特定训练即可适应新游戏或场景的通用智能体。

metadata.trends: A shift from reinforcement-learning-based agents to LLM-powered generalist agents that combine reasoning, memory, and planning for long-horizon tasks, with increasing emphasis on multimodal perception and in-context learning.

application_domain:scientific-research-a.en: This sub-category focuses on developing LLM-powered agents that assist in various stages of scientific research, such as data analysis, experimentation, literature survey, and knowledge graph construction. Typical tasks include automated data collection, insight generation, experiment design, and tool creation from research papers. The goal is to reduce human effort and accelerate discovery by automating complex, multi-step research workflows. Recent work emphasizes end-to-end problem solving and iterative refinement of agent outputs.
application_domain:scientific-research-a.zh: 该子类别专注于开发由大语言模型驱动的智能体，协助科学研究的不同阶段，如数据分析、实验、文献调研和知识图谱构建。典型任务包括自动数据收集、洞察生成、实验设计以及从研究论文中创建工具。目标是通过自动化复杂的多步研究流程来减少人力并加速发现。近期工作强调端到端问题解决和智能体输出的迭代优化。

metadata.trends: Agents are evolving from single-turn assistants to autonomous systems capable of end-to-end research workflows, with increasing focus on real-world complexity and generalizability.

application_domain:multi-agent.en: Multi-agent research focuses on systems where multiple LLM-powered agents collaborate to solve complex tasks that require diverse expertise, planning, and coordination. Typical tasks include code generation, mobile GUI automation, game testing, video recommendation, and graphic design review. Approaches often involve role assignment, chain-of-thought reasoning, and retrieval-augmented generation to improve task decomposition, execution verification, and error recovery. The goal is to achieve higher accuracy, coverage, and adaptability compared to single-agent or monolithic models.
application_domain:multi-agent.zh: 多智能体研究关注由多个大语言模型驱动的智能体协作解决复杂任务，这些任务需要多样化的专业知识、规划和协调。典型任务包括代码生成、移动GUI自动化、游戏测试、视频推荐和图形设计评审。常用方法涉及角色分配、思维链推理和检索增强生成，以改进任务分解、执行验证和错误恢复。目标是实现比单智能体或单一模型更高的准确性、覆盖率和适应性。

metadata.trends: Recent trends focus on integrating retrieval augmentation and specialized tools to enhance agent capabilities, and applying multi-agent systems to more diverse and real-world domains such as mobile automation, game testing, and fair resource allocation.

application_domain:mobile-agent/mobile-c.en: This research focuses on techniques to enable mobile agents to operate across different platforms and devices. Typical tasks include automated test generation for cross-platform apps, converting UI designs between phones and tablets, and planning multi-API execution for complex user instructions. Methods leverage large language models for code/test generation, multimodal learning for UI matching, and benchmark design for evaluating multi-step reasoning.
application_domain:mobile-agent/mobile-c.zh: 该研究方向关注使移动智能体跨平台和设备运行的技术。典型任务包括跨平台应用的自动化测试生成、手机与平板间UI设计转换，以及为复杂用户指令规划多API执行。方法利用大语言模型进行代码/测试生成、多模态学习进行UI匹配，以及基准测试设计来评估多步推理能力。

methods: Large Language Model (LLM) for test/code generation
metadata.trends: Leveraging large language models and multimodal AI to automate cross-platform mobile development and testing, with an increasing focus on complex multi-step reasoning and real-world application.

application_domain:scientific-research-a.en: This category focuses on using language model agents to autonomously conduct machine learning experimentation, including designing, running, and analyzing experiments, and iterating based on results. Typical tasks involve improving model performance on benchmarks like CIFAR-10 or BabyLM. Core methods include the ReAct framework for agent-environment interaction, executing code, and interpreting outputs. Key challenges are the need for extensive prior knowledge and variable success rates, especially on recent research problems.
application_domain:scientific-research-a.zh: 该类别研究使用语言模型代理自主进行机器学习实验，包括设计、运行、分析实验并根据结果迭代。典型任务是在CIFAR-10或BabyLM等基准上提升模型性能。核心方法包括ReAct框架用于代理与环境交互、执行代码和解释输出。主要挑战是需要大量先验知识，且成功率变化大，尤其是在最新研究问题上。

metadata.trends: Recent trend involves using more powerful LLMs (e.g., GPT-4, Claude 3 Opus) to enhance autonomous experimentation, achieving higher success on established benchmarks but struggling with cutting-edge tasks.

application_domain:tool-use.en: This category covers research on the use of tools by LLM-based agents, including how agents select, invoke, and interact with external tools such as APIs, GUI elements, or software functions. Typical tasks include tool selection, prompt injection attacks on tool systems, automated GUI prototyping and testing, and adaptation of agents to dynamic environments. Methods often involve retrieval-augmented generation, few-shot learning, program synthesis, and security analysis. The goal is to enhance agent autonomy, efficiency, and safety in real-world applications.
application_domain:tool-use.zh: 该类别涵盖基于大语言模型的智能体使用工具的研究，包括智能体如何选择、调用和与外部工具（如API、GUI元素或软件功能）交互。典型任务包括工具选择、针对工具系统的提示注入攻击、自动化GUI原型设计与测试，以及智能体在动态环境中的适应。常用方法包括检索增强生成、少样本学习、程序合成和安全性分析。目标是提升智能体在现实应用中的自主性、效率和安全性。

metadata.trends: Recent trend focuses on security aspects like prompt injection attacks, automated tool creation and enrichment, and the development of standardized protocols (e.g., MCP) for scalable agent-tool interaction.

application_domain:multi-domain-agent.en: Multi-domain agent research focuses on developing and analyzing LLM-based agents that can operate across diverse tasks and environments by integrating multiple tools, sub-agents, or APIs. Typical goals include autonomous task completion, robust tool selection, and safe multi-step reasoning. Researchers tackle challenges such as prompt injection attacks, tool discovery and enrichment, multi-agent coordination, and benchmark evaluation for both capability and harmfulness. This category covers security architectures, automated API conversion, reinforcement learning for user simulation, and generalist agent platforms.
application_domain:multi-domain-agent.zh: 多域智能体研究专注于开发和分析基于大语言模型的智能体，这些智能体能够通过整合多种工具、子智能体或API，在多样化的任务和环境中运行。典型目标包括自主任务完成、稳健工具选择以及安全的多步推理。研究者应对提示注入攻击、工具发现与增强、多智能体协作以及能力和危害性基准评估等挑战。该类别涵盖安全架构、自动化API转换、用于用户模拟的强化学习以及通用智能体平台。

metadata.trends: Research is increasingly moving from narrow, single-task agents to generalist agents that can flexibly operate across multiple domains, with a growing emphasis on safety, security, and real-world deployment.

application_domain:web-agent.en: Web agent research focuses on developing LLM-powered systems that autonomously interact with graphical user interfaces (GUIs) to perform tasks such as navigation, form filling, and information retrieval. Typical goals include automating repetitive web tasks, improving accessibility, and enabling natural language control of software. Common methods involve reinforcement learning, multimodal large language models (MLLMs), computer vision for GUI grounding, and test-time reasoning strategies. Key challenges include robust element localization, handling dynamic interfaces, and reducing the computational cost of agent operation.
application_domain:web-agent.zh: Web Agent研究关注开发由大语言模型驱动的系统，使其能够自主与图形用户界面（GUI）交互，执行导航、表单填写和信息检索等任务。典型目标包括自动化重复性网页操作、提升可访问性，以及实现通过自然语言控制软件。常用方法包括强化学习、多模态大语言模型（MLLM）、用于GUI定位的计算机视觉，以及测试时推理策略。关键挑战包括鲁棒的元素定位、处理动态界面，以及降低智能体运行的计算成本。

metadata.trends: Recent research emphasizes test-time scaling, active visual perception, and energy-aware agent design, moving beyond static one-shot predictions to more adaptive and efficient web interaction.

application_domain:scientific-research-a.en: This category focuses on using LLM-powered agents to automate and enhance various stages of the literature review process. Typical tasks include dynamic fact-checking, information discovery, selection, organization, and exploratory search across scientific literature. Methods often involve multi-agent frameworks, cluster-based navigation, and iterative probing to evaluate model capabilities beyond simple accuracy, emphasizing justification and coherence. Recent work aims to replace static benchmarks with adaptive, scalable evaluation environments that simulate real-world research workflows.
application_domain:scientific-research-a.zh: 该类别专注于利用基于LLM的智能体自动化和增强文献综述的各个阶段。典型任务包括动态事实核查、信息发现、筛选、组织以及科学文献中的探索性搜索。常见方法涉及多智能体框架、基于聚类的导航以及迭代探测，以评估模型在简单准确性之外的能力，强调论证与连贯性。近期工作旨在用自适应、可扩展的评估环境取代静态基准，模拟真实研究流程。

metadata.trends: Moving from static, accuracy-based benchmarks to dynamic, adaptive evaluation frameworks that assess comprehensive research skills such as information organization and justification.

application_domain:web-agent/web-h5-hybr.en: This category covers research on web-based agents that combine traditional text-based interaction with dynamically generated graphical user interfaces (GUIs) in hybrid chat-web environments. The core technique involves using large language models (LLMs) to generate HTML code on-the-fly, which is rendered into interactive widgets such as buttons, forms, or sliders during a conversation. The primary goal is to reduce cognitive load and task completion time for complex, multi-turn tasks by replacing lengthy text exchanges with intuitive visual elements. A key challenge is ensuring the generated GUIs are contextually appropriate and seamlessly integrated into the chat flow.
application_domain:web-agent/web-h5-hybr.zh: 该类别涵盖将传统文本交互与动态生成的图形用户界面（GUI）相结合的混合聊天-网页环境中的基于Web的智能体研究。核心技术是利用大型语言模型（LLMs）实时生成HTML代码，并将其渲染为按钮、表单或滑块等交互式小部件。主要目标是通过用直观的视觉元素替代冗长的文本交流，来降低复杂多轮任务的认知负荷和任务完成时间。一个关键挑战是确保生成的GUI在上下文上合适且无缝集成到聊天流程中。

methods: User experience evaluation through comparative studies
metadata.trends: Recent trends focus on leveraging LLMs to create adaptive, context-aware graphical interfaces within conversational systems to improve usability and efficiency.

application_domain:multi-domain-agent/.en: This category covers research on agents that operate across multiple domains, such as computer tasks, cybersecurity, tool use, and human interaction. Key methods include LLM-guided program synthesis, hierarchical memory management, and multi-agent orchestration. Typical tasks involve long-horizon planning, dynamic tool integration, and adaptation to novel environments. The goal is to build generalist agents that are scalable, adaptable, and secure against threats like prompt injection.
application_domain:multi-domain-agent/.zh: 该类别涵盖跨多领域（如计算机操作、网络安全、工具使用和人机交互）的智能体研究。主要方法包括LLM引导的程序合成、分层记忆管理和多智能体编排。典型任务涉及长周期规划、动态工具集成以及对新环境的适应。目标是构建可扩展、适应性强且能抵御提示注入等威胁的通用智能体。

metadata.trends: Recent trend towards developing generalist agents that can scale across domains with dynamic integration, real-time adaptation, and robust security against adversarial attacks.

application_domain:scientific-research-a.en: This category covers research on developing and evaluating large language model (LLM) based agents for automated data analysis in scientific and business contexts. Typical tasks include end-to-end data analytics, knowledge graph construction from urban data, tool creation from code repositories, and feedback triage. The goal is to create autonomous agents that can plan, execute, and debug data analysis workflows, generate actionable insights, and reduce human effort. Key methods involve LLM-powered reasoning, tool augmentation, trajectory refinement, and closed-loop self-correction.
application_domain:scientific-research-a.zh: 该类别涵盖在科学和商业环境中开发与评估基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体，以实现自动化数据分析。典型任务包括端到端数据分析、从城市数据构建知识图谱、从代码仓库创建工具以及反馈分类。目标是构建能够规划、执行和调试数据分析流程，生成可操作见解，并减少人力投入的自主智能体。关键方法涉及LLM驱动的推理、工具增强、轨迹优化以及闭环自我纠正。

datasets: UrbanKG construction datasets (e.g., from smart city data)
metadata.trends: Recent evolution focuses on moving from single-query answering to fully autonomous, multi-step data analysis agents capable of dynamic tool creation and adaptation to specialized domains.

application_domain:tool-use/function-cal.en: This category focuses on enabling large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) to invoke external tools, APIs, or functions to accomplish complex tasks. Research covers tool selection, parameter filling, multi-step orchestration, and dynamic adaptation to environmental changes. Typical methods include fine-tuning on tool-use trajectories, multi-agent collaboration, and neuro-symbolic reasoning. The goal is to build agents that can autonomously plan and execute real-world workflows, such as software development, data analysis, or UI design.
application_domain:tool-use/function-cal.zh: 该类别专注于使大型语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）能够调用外部工具、API或函数来完成复杂任务。研究涵盖工具选择、参数填充、多步编排以及对环境变化的动态适应。典型方法包括基于工具使用轨迹的微调、多智能体协作以及神经符号推理。目标是构建能够自主规划并执行真实世界工作流的智能体，例如软件开发、数据分析或用户界面设计。

metadata.trends: Recent evolution emphasizes dynamic, adaptive tool usage with multi-agent coordination and robust handling of real-world, multi-step interactive scenarios.

application_domain:web-agent/web-page-un.en: Web page understanding research aims to enable models to comprehend web pages from multiple modalities, including screenshots, raw HTML, and combined visual-textual structure. Typical tasks include page description generation, section summarization, contextual image captioning, semantic classification of HTML elements, and description generation for UI inputs. Core methods leverage large pretrained models such as vision-language models (e.g., Pix2Struct) or language models fine-tuned on HTML (e.g., T5), often incorporating attention mechanisms that exploit page structure. The main challenge is integrating visual, textual, and structural information without relying on costly manual annotations, while handling the diversity of real-world web layouts.
application_domain:web-agent/web-page-un.zh: 网页理解研究旨在使模型能够从多种模态（包括截图、原始HTML以及视觉-文本组合结构）理解网页。典型任务包括页面描述生成、章节摘要、上下文图像描述、HTML元素的语义分类以及UI输入描述生成。核心方法利用大规模预训练模型，如视觉-语言模型（如Pix2Struct）或针对HTML微调的语言模型（如T5），并常结合利用页面结构的注意力机制。主要挑战是在不依赖昂贵人工标注的情况下整合视觉、文本和结构信息，同时应对真实网页布局的多样性。

methods: Fine-tuning large language models on raw HTML
Attention mechanisms (e.g., Prefix Global) leveraging page structure
Transfer learning from web-scale data to UI understanding
metadata.trends: Recent work increasingly adopts large pretrained models (LLMs and VLMs) and exploits web-scale data to improve generalization, moving away from task-specific architectures and synthetic data.

application_domain:web-agent/web-navigat.en: This category focuses on developing intelligent agents that can autonomously navigate and interact with web interfaces, mimicking human browsing behavior. Research covers tasks such as visual grounding of GUI elements, automated web testing, interactive webpage code generation from prototypes, and web accessibility auditing. Core methods include reinforcement learning for sequential decision-making, multimodal large language models for visual-language understanding, computer vision for element detection, and natural language processing for instruction interpretation. Key challenges include handling dynamic web content, ensuring robust visual grounding across diverse layouts, and achieving scalable, energy-efficient deployment in production environments.
application_domain:web-agent/web-navigat.zh: 该类别专注于开发能够自主导航和交互网页界面的智能代理，模拟人类浏览行为。研究涵盖GUI元素的视觉定位、自动化网页测试、从原型生成交互式网页代码以及网页可访问性审计等任务。核心方法包括用于序列决策的强化学习、用于视觉-语言理解的多模态大语言模型、用于元素检测的计算机视觉以及用于指令解析的自然语言处理。主要挑战包括处理动态网页内容、确保跨多种布局的鲁棒视觉定位，以及在生产环境中实现可扩展、节能的部署。

metadata.trends: Recent work emphasizes combining reinforcement learning with vision-language models for adaptive visual perception, and extending evaluation from static benchmarks to real-world enterprise deployments with focus on energy efficiency and human-AI collaboration.

application_domain:web-agent/web-informa.en: Web information-seeking research focuses on developing agents that autonomously explore, aggregate, and reason over information from multiple websites or web sources to answer complex queries. Typical tasks include multi-hop web navigation, long-form question answering, and information aggregation across diverse domains. Core methods combine large language models with retrieval-augmented generation, multi-agent frameworks, and interactive browsing to iteratively gather and synthesize evidence. This direction is distinct from simpler web navigation by emphasizing deep, context-dependent information gathering and reasoning over open-ended, real-world queries.
application_domain:web-agent/web-informa.zh: 网页信息搜索研究专注于开发能够自主探索、聚合和推理多个网站或网络信息源以回答复杂查询的智能体。典型任务包括多跳网页导航、长文本问答以及跨域信息聚合。核心方法结合大语言模型与检索增强生成、多智能体框架和交互式浏览，以迭代地收集和综合证据。这一方向与简单网页导航的区别在于强调深度、上下文相关的信息收集以及对开放现实世界查询的推理。

methods: LLM-based planning and reasoning with tool use
Interactive web browsing with visual and textual grounding
metadata.trends: Recent trends emphasize synthetic data generation and supervised fine-tuning over reinforcement learning, integration of multimodal understanding, and evaluation of cultural and social awareness in web-based information seeking.

application_domain:web-agent/web-task-au.en: This category focuses on developing autonomous agents that perform complex tasks on real-world websites by interpreting natural language instructions. Research addresses improving task success through better observation and action alignment, exploration strategies like Monte Carlo Tree Search, and safety mechanisms. Typical goals include building generalist agents that handle diverse websites and tasks, with recent emphasis on efficiency, scalability, and practical deployment in enterprise environments.
application_domain:web-agent/web-task-au.zh: 该类别专注于开发能够通过自然语言指令在真实网站上执行复杂任务的自主智能体。研究涵盖通过改进观察与动作对齐、探索策略（如蒙特卡洛树搜索）以及安全机制来提高任务成功率的方法。典型目标包括构建能够处理多样化网站和任务的通用智能体，近期特别关注效率、可扩展性以及在企业环境中的实际部署。

metadata.trends: There is a growing focus on deploying web agents in production environments, emphasizing safety, energy efficiency, and the ability to generalize across unseen tasks and websites.

application_domain:web-agent/web-shop.en: Research in this category develops and evaluates large language model (LLM) based agents for performing online shopping tasks, such as product search, purchase, customer support, and personalized recommendations.
